Purpose: This rmd is dedicated towards the CCA analysis and supporting materials
- Run CCA comparing community composition and all env vars
- Run CCA comparing community comppostion across depth
- Supporting CCA plots

Necessary Environment Objects
- bugs: ISP main markdown

Environment Objects Created
- bugs_agg
- cca_dat
- comm2

### Set Up

```{r}
library(vegan)
library(permute)
library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(ggrepel)
```

### Data Frame Building

```{r}
#define env cols
env_cols <- c("tempDepth", "doDepth", "conductivityDepth", "pHDepth")

# build data frame
bugs_agg <- bugs %>%
  group_by(stream, depth) %>%
  summarise(
    across(all_of(c(species_cols, env_cols)), ~ mean(.x, na.rm = TRUE)),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  mutate(depth = factor(depth))

#env data separation
cca_dat <- bugs_agg %>%
  select(stream, depth, tempDepth, doDepth, conductivityDepth, pHDepth)

sample_labels <- paste(
  as.character(cca_dat$stream),
  as.character(cca_dat$depth),
  sep = "-"
)

#species data separation
comm2 <- bugs_agg %>%
  select(all_of(species_cols)) %>%
  as.data.frame()

rownames(comm2) <- sample_labels
```

### Model Building

*Q1: Does community composition differ among depths within streams?*

```{r}
cca_depth <- vegan::cca(
  comm2 ~ depth + Condition(stream),
  data = cca_dat
)

depth_perm <- permute::how(
  nperm = 4999,
  blocks = cca_dat$stream
)

anova(cca_depth, permutations = depth_perm)
```
significant difference in community composition across depths after accounting for stream


*Q2: Is community composition associated with temperature differences among streams*
```{r}
cca_env <- vegan::cca(
  comm2 ~ tempDepth + doDepth + conductivityDepth + pHDepth +
    Condition(depth),
  data = cca_dat
)

stream_perm <- permute::how(
  nperm = 4999,
  within = permute::Within(type = "none"),
  plots = permute::Plots(strata = cca_dat$stream, type = "free")
)

# Overall test of the environmental predictors
anova(
  cca_env,
  permutations = stream_perm
)

# Test each predictor after accounting for the others
anova(
  cca_env,
  by = "margin",
  permutations = stream_perm
)
```
*Q3: How are individual taxa abundances related to temp*
```{r}
library(glmmTMB)

comm <- as.data.frame(comm2)
dat <- cca_dat

stopifnot(nrow(comm) == nrow(dat))

# Fit a negative-binomial model for each species.
# The stream random intercept accounts for samples grouped within streams.
test_one_species <- function(sp) {
  d <- dat
  d$abundance <- comm[[sp]]

  full <- glmmTMB(
    abundance ~ tempDepth + depth + (1 | stream),
    family = nbinom2,
    data = d
  )

  reduced <- update(full, . ~ . - tempDepth)

  # Likelihood-ratio test of whether adding temperature improves fit
  test <- anova(reduced, full)
  p <- test$`Pr(>Chisq)`[2]

  # Temperature effect as a multiplicative change in expected abundance
 coef_tab <- summary(full)$coefficients$cond
beta <- coef_tab["tempDepth", "Estimate"]
se <- coef_tab["tempDepth", "Std. Error"]

# 95% Wald confidence interval on the log scale, then exponentiate
ci <- beta + c(-1, 1) * qnorm(0.975) * se

data.frame(
  species = sp,
  rate_ratio = exp(beta),
  conf_low = exp(ci[1]),
  conf_high = exp(ci[2]),
  p_value = p
)
}

results <- do.call(
  rbind,
  lapply(names(comm), test_one_species)
)

# Adjust for testing multiple species
results$p_adjusted <- p.adjust(results$p_value, method = "BH")
results[order(results$p_adjusted), ]
```



### Plots

*Q1*
```{r}
# Get species and depth-centroid scores
species_scores <- vegan::scores(
  cca_depth, display = "species", choices = 1:2, scaling = 2
)
depth_scores <- vegan::scores(
  cca_depth, display = "cn", choices = 1:2, scaling = 2
)

# Set up the plot
plot(
  cca_depth,
  scaling = 2,
  display = c("species", "cn"),
  type = "n",
  main = "CCA of Community Composition by Depth"
)

# Add species names
text(
  species_scores,
  labels = rownames(species_scores),
  cex = 0.8
)

# Add and label depth centroids
points(depth_scores[, 1:2], pch = 21, bg = "lightblue")
text(
  depth_scores[, 1:2],
  labels = rownames(depth_scores),
  pos = 3,
  cex = 0.9,
  col = "blue"
)
```


*Q2*

```{r}
# Set up the plot area for species and environmental-variable scores
plot(
  cca_env,
  scaling = 2,
  display = c("species", "bp"),
  type = "n",
  main = "CCA of Community Composition and Environmental Variables"
)

species_scores <- vegan::scores(
  cca_env, display = "species", choices = 1:2, scaling = 2
)
env_scores <- vegan::scores(
  cca_env, display = "bp", choices = 1:2, scaling = 2
)

# Add species names
text(species_scores, labels = rownames(species_scores), cex = 0.8)

# Fit arrows to the plot and label them with display names
arrow_mult <- vegan::ordiArrowMul(env_scores)
arrows(
  0, 0,
  env_scores[, 1] * arrow_mult,
  env_scores[, 2] * arrow_mult,
  length = 0.08,
  col = "blue"
)

env_labels <- c(
  tempDepth = "Temperature",
  doDepth = "Dissolved Oxygen",
  pHDepth = "pH",
  conductivityDepth = "Conductivity"
)
labels <- env_labels[rownames(env_scores)]
labels[is.na(labels)] <- rownames(env_scores)[is.na(labels)]

text(
  env_scores[, 1] * arrow_mult,
  env_scores[, 2] * arrow_mult,
  labels = labels,
  col = "blue",
  pos = 3,
  cex = 0.9
)
```


## Appendix

### Depth Separation

```{r}
# 25
cca_dat_25 <- bugs_agg %>%
  filter(depth == "25") %>%
  select(stream, tempDepth, doDepth, conductivityDepth, pHDepth)

comm2_25 <- bugs_agg %>%
  filter(depth == "25") %>%
  select(all_of(species_cols)) %>%
  as.data.frame()

cca_mod_25 <- cca(
  comm2_25 ~ tempDepth + doDepth + conductivityDepth + pHDepth,
  data = cca_dat_25)


# 50
cca_dat_50 <- bugs_agg %>%
  filter(depth == "50") %>%
  select(stream, tempDepth, doDepth, conductivityDepth, pHDepth)

comm2_50 <- bugs_agg %>%
  filter(depth == "50") %>%
  select(all_of(species_cols)) %>%
  as.data.frame()

cca_mod_50 <- cca(
  comm2_50 ~ tempDepth + doDepth + conductivityDepth + pHDepth,
  data = cca_dat_50)


# surber
cca_dat_surber <- bugs_agg %>%
  filter(depth == "surber") %>%
  select(stream, tempDepth, doDepth, conductivityDepth, pHDepth)

comm2_surber <- bugs_agg %>%
  filter(depth == "surber") %>%
  select(all_of(species_cols)) %>%
  as.data.frame()

cca_mod_surber <- cca(
  comm2_surber ~ tempDepth + doDepth + conductivityDepth + pHDepth,
  data = cca_dat_surber)
```

#### Model Output
```{r}
summary(cca_mod_25)
summary(cca_mod_50)
summary(cca_mod_surber)

set.seed(2026)

plot(cca_mod_25, scaling = 2)
plot(cca_mod_50, scaling = 2)
plot(cca_mod_surber, scaling = 2)

anova(cca_mod_25, permutations = 9999)
anova(cca_mod_25, by = "margin", permutations = 9999)
